t.agency.CA_AB418_2027: Banned for use in food from 2027 under California law AB 418.
t.agency.EFSA_ADI_2017: It was stated that estimated intake may exceed the daily limit in some consumer groups.
t.agency.EU_CLP_Repr1B: Classified under CLP as toxic for reproduction, category 1B.
t.agency.EU_allergen_label: Must be indicated on the label as an allergen (1169/2011 Annex II).
t.agency.EU_not_listed: Not included in the EU list of authorised food additives.
t.agency.EU_warning_label: Products containing it must carry the warning “may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children” (1333/2008 Annex V).
t.agency.IARC_2A_koşullu: Group 2A classification (probably carcinogenic to humans) for the substance or its by-product; conditional.
t.agency.IARC_2B_4MEI: The by-product 4-MEI, which may form during production, is in Group 2B (possibly carcinogenic to humans).
t.cat.acidity_regulator.what: Alters or controls the acidity or alkalinity of a food; the mineral salts in this group are also used as raising agents, firming agents or stabilisers.
t.cat.anticaking.what: Reduces the tendency of particles in powdered foods to stick together and form lumps.
t.cat.antioxidant.what: Extends shelf life by delaying deterioration caused by oxidation, such as fat rancidity and colour changes.
t.cat.colour.what: Adds colour to a food or restores colour lost during processing.
t.cat.emulsifier.what: Keeps substances that do not normally mix, such as oil and water, mixed together.
t.cat.flavour_enhancer.what: Enhances the existing taste or odour of a food.
t.cat.gas.what: A protective gas placed in the packaging instead of air, or a propellant gas used to expel a food from its container.
t.cat.glazing_agent.what: Gives the outer surface of a food a shiny appearance or a protective coating.
t.cat.koz_antioks.what: Protects the product and its oils from oxidation.
t.cat.koz_bakim.what: An active ingredient added for skin or hair care.
t.cat.koz_kivam.what: Thickens the product and keeps the mixture stable.
t.cat.koz_koku.what: Gives the product its scent; some are fragrance allergens.
t.cat.koz_koruyucu.what: Prevents water-based products from spoiling through microbial growth.
t.cat.koz_nem.what: Binds water to keep skin and hair moist.
t.cat.koz_selat.what: Binds metal ions in water and in the product.
t.cat.koz_uv.what: Absorbs or reflects the sun's ultraviolet (UV) rays.
t.cat.koz_yumusatici.what: Forms a thin layer on the skin that softens it and reduces water loss.
t.cat.koz_yuzey.what: Removes dirt and oil with water and creates foam.
t.cat.modified_starch.what: Starch whose properties have been changed by physical, enzymatic or chemical treatment; it mostly thickens and keeps the thickness during heat treatment.
t.cat.other.what: Performs auxiliary functions, such as carrying or dissolving other additives or preventing a food from drying out.
t.cat.preservative.what: Extends the shelf life of a food by delaying spoilage caused by micro-organisms (bacteria, moulds, yeasts).
t.cat.stabiliser.what: Maintains the physical and chemical state of a food or adds volume without significantly increasing its energy value.
t.cat.sweetener.what: Used to give a food a sweet taste or as a table-top sweetener.
t.cat.tem_agartici.what: Whitens stains by oxidising them; most also kill germs.
t.cat.tem_alkali.what: Dissolves grease and dirt and raises the product's pH.
t.cat.tem_asit.what: Dissolves limescale, rust and mineral deposits.
t.cat.tem_cozucu.what: Dissolves grease and dirt; most evaporate quickly.
t.cat.tem_enzim.what: Breaks down protein, starch or fat stains.
t.cat.tem_koku.what: Gives the product its scent; some are fragrance allergens.
t.cat.tem_koruyucu.what: Stops a water-based product from spoiling through microbial growth.
t.cat.tem_su.what: Binds calcium and magnesium in water so the detergent works better.
t.cat.tem_yuzey.what: The main cleaning agent: lifts dirt and grease off surfaces and keeps them suspended in water.
t.cat.thickener.what: Increases the thickness of a food or gives it texture by forming a gel.
t.eff.doctor: If you have a complaint, consult your doctor. This list is not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
t.eff.none_text: No known side effects with normal use.
t.eval.inventory: It does not meet any of this app's warning criteria (EU ban, mandatory warning, IARC classification, etc.). This is not an approval.

t.flag.hyperactivity.0: Products containing this colour must carry a warning that it may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children.
t.flag.hyperactivity.1: Products containing this colour must carry a warning that it may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children.
t.flag.sodium.0: It is a source of sodium. Sodium from additives is usually less than that from salt.

t.koz.eff.miktar: The classification applies to the pure substance; cosmetics use it diluted, so the effect in a product depends on its concentration.
t.koz.eval: The colour follows the same rule as the cosmetics result in Label Reader: the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation and the monitored lists. Labels do not state concentrations, so the amount in a product is unknown. 'No specific warning' is not an endorsement.
t.koz.pw.ed: On the EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (substances suspected of affecting the hormone system). The list is not a verdict.
t.koz.pw.koku: Fragrance allergen: in the EU it must be named in the ingredient list above a set level; look for its name on the label.
t.koz.reg.yok: Not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation (prohibited, restricted and permitted lists); there is no limit or labelling rule specific to this substance. The general safety assessment rule applies to every product.
t.reg.tr_listed: In Türkiye, included in the Turkish Food Codex list of permitted additives.
t.reg.tr_not_listed: In Türkiye, not included in the current (2023) Turkish Food Codex list of permitted additives.
t.tem.eff.miktar: The classification applies to the pure or concentrated substance; the effect in a product depends on its concentration and is stated in the hazard statements on the label.
t.tem.eff.yok: Not in any EU hazard class (registrants' joint notification).
t.tem.eval: The colour follows the most serious of the substance's EU hazard classes (the same rule as the cleaning result screen). The classification applies to the pure substance; the product's own hazard statements are on its label.

t.tem.h.H304: H304 May be fatal if swallowed and enters airways.

t.tem.h.H317: H317 May cause an allergic skin reaction.
t.tem.h.H400: H400 Very toxic to aquatic life.
